title: griddle ok, grill.. meh. Not as great as I wanted it to be.
text: griddle ok, grill.. meh. Not as great as I wanted it to be.. We use nothing but cast iron pans, so we know how to use them and how to take care of them.I thought it would be great to have a griddle/grill to use right on our gas stove; especially the grill side. After some careful reading, I selected this pan. I am not terribly impressed with it. I know griddles are pretty flat, as I have a super old round cast iron griddle that has been used for pancakes, etc. However, I am not real comfortable with the low sides when using it as a grill. It is much too easy to get splatter and splash back from anything that is cooking down fat. That, and the two cut outs are more apt to expose the area to flame. Again, we use cast iron every single time we cook, but this is just sitting in a drawer. I think I will look for a grill only item. Overall, I think it is an OK product as a griddle, and slightly less so as a grill.  And yes, everything stuck to it despite having plenty of oil. Further seasoning should enhance the performance, but this was annoying. I find that although using cast iron on a gas range is awesome, I will just use a large skillet, or even get out my electric skillet rather than use this item.
